options.name: Keystone
options.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one polished original logo proposal for "Rock Solid Church", a modern contemporary church in the Phoenix Valley. The desired sensibility is Apple-esque: extraordinary simplicity, optical balance, confident proportions, beautifully restrained and precise, with an original identity of its own. Flat vector-like graphic design, crisp edges, solid charcoal-black ink on pure white background. No mockups, photography, texture, gradients, lighting effects, shadows, bevels, metallic materials, or decorative flourishes. One generously spaced centered logo lockup only: symbol above the exact words "Rock Solid" with "CHURCH" in smaller widely tracked capitals beneath. Refined contemporary sans-serif typography, excellent kerning, clear legibility. Broad white margins. Do not include option numbers, descriptive captions, slogans, or any additional text. Design should remain clear at small icon scale and translate naturally to building signage. Direction: a compact, bold, geometric stone/keystone silhouette, subtly asymmetric with an expertly proportioned negative-space Christian cross cut into the solid shape. A single strong recognizable silhouette with a stable flat foundation and softly eased corners. The cross should feel structurally integrated, spacious and precise, never a pasted-on ornament. Architectural rather than illustrative. Avoid mountains, landscapes, stacked stones, and church-building illustrations.
